label: Stationary
notes: GPS speed is zero; IMU is at baseline.

label: Clutch Release
notes: Brief multi-axis vibration without sustained longitudinal acceleration.

label: Harsh Acceleration
notes: Sustained positive longitudinal acceleration with rising GPS speed.

label: Normal Driving
notes: Cruise and a yaw/lateral turn; no harsh event.

label: Harsh Braking
notes: Sustained negative longitudinal acceleration with falling GPS speed.

label: Pothole/Bump
notes: Large vertical spike/dip with pitch response.

label: Normal Driving
notes: Includes gentle deceleration to a stop; deliberately not harsh braking.

label: Clutch Release
notes: Short multi-axis vibration while nearly stopped.
